result.reviewScopeSummary: Reviewed Story 0 Foundation against the story spec, Epic 7 tech design, and test plan, then inspected the shared archive contracts, server schemas, Convex table/index skeletons, PlatformStore seam additions, compatibility mapper, fixtures, and affected test doubles. Verified the story-local contract coverage through the implemented test surface and confirmed the configured story gate passes in the current workspace; no story-local blocking defects or reachable production-path shim issues were established from the evidence reviewed.

verified: S0-REQ-1 shared archive/turn/derived-view/pagination/error contracts and route builders exist and are exported from the shared contract root
S0-REQ-2 server archive schemas validate archive and turn pagination plus the empty derived-view refresh body
S0-REQ-3 Convex schema includes archiveEntries, archiveTurns, and derivedArchiveViews table/index skeletons aligned to the Story 0 vocabulary
S0-REQ-4 PlatformStore plus NullPlatformStore, ConvexPlatformStore, InMemoryPlatformStore, and touched test doubles expose the archive seam methods required by later stories
S0-REQ-5 archive fixtures cover all seven entry kinds plus degraded entries, turns, derived views, and paginated envelopes
S0-REQ-6 ProcessHistoryCompatService provides an explicit finalized-only compatibility mapping and does not backfill unsupported history kinds

additionalObservations: `corepack pnpm run verify-all` failed outside the Story 0 surface in `packages/lbuild-impl` integration suites because `zod` could not be resolved from `packages/lbuild-impl/src/core/result-contracts.ts` and `packages/lbuild-impl/src/core/runtime-identity.ts`; none of the Story 0 touched files are in that failure path.

The story gate completed successfully even with a repo-wide Biome informational style notice in `packages/lbuild-impl/tests/unit/sdk/story-orchestrate-status.test.ts:173`; the notice did not fail `green-verify`.

Production-path audit found no new reachable archive runtime path in Story 0 beyond seam definitions: the new archive store methods are not yet invoked by any route or service call site outside tests/platform-store scaffolding.
